product.name: Ava AI Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered voice assistant that handles patient calls, scheduling, insurance verification, and integrates with EHR systems to automate front desk operations.

product.name: Specialty-Specific AI Agents
product.description: Customized AI assistants trained on specialty-specific medical knowledge to automate scheduling, patient intake, and clinical workflows for various medical fields.

product.name: AI-Powered Patient Intake Automation
product.description: An AI system that automates patient intake by collecting medical history, insurance details, and consent forms using specialty-specific questions.

product.name: Custom AI Scribe & Clinical Documentation
product.description: AI-generated clinical documentation and SOAP notes tailored to specialty-specific templates and integrated with EHR systems to reduce documentation time.

product.name: Real-Time Insurance Verification
product.description: An AI-enabled service that verifies patient insurance coverage and benefits in real time during scheduling and intake processes.
